u0: Safe initial and designated final state: the locked target door has not been opened at any earlier step. Preserve this condition by never toggling the locked door open, including while carrying the matching key, and avoid any action that would make target_door_open true. If the episode ends while still in u0, the requirement to never open the locked door has been satisfied without penalty.
u1: Violation sink state: the locked target door has been opened at least once, so the -1 penalty has been incurred and the 'never open the locked door' condition is permanently failed. There is no transition back to u0 even if the door is later closed; the policy should avoid entering this state.
